items.summary: HIP-Vulkan texture interop stubbed (importToCuda mipmapped-array export): hipExternalMemoryGetMappedMipmappedArray is not exported by libamdhip64 in ROCm 7.2. Core rasterization works.

gfx90a ROCm 7.2.1: hipModuleLaunchKernel dispatches from inside HipModularProgram::launch()/launch2D memory-fault (addr nil, xnack-) while byte-identical inline sequences at the same call sites pass. Exhaustively bisected (args/Timer/launch API/module/order/sync/kernarg-lifetime/fast-math eliminated; machine code verified). Repro: CURAST_LADDER=1 on AMD-Ecosystem/CuRast branch bench. Workaround shipped: inline dispatch (INLINE_LAUNCH_1D/2D). Needs ROCm runtime-level debug (kernarg pool / queue state).
